description: Fetch an OpenEvidence article by article_id. Use after history lookup or oe_ask returns an article ID. Inputs: article_id UUID, optional include_raw=false. Returns normalized status, question, and answer fields by default. include_raw=true may expose private thread context and must be used only with explicit user intent. Requires authenticated session. No side effects.
name: oe_article_get
title: OpenEvidence Article Get
